original_test_intent: Verify a fully populated platform survives 100 warm OS reboots at 0C/-5% rails without device loss or platform errors.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Populate all CPU/DIMM/HDD/GPU/network slots and reboot 100 times under the specified margin.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: No disallowed BMC/system error, hang/blue screen, or missing device.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED MANUAL ONLY with explicit boot-ready, inventory, cycle and no-hidden-retry controls.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Operator owns the environmental fixture; PA Manager Cycle or the approved project cycle script may control warm reboots and evidence.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Fully populated platform, 0C/-5% rails, 100 warm reboots.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Reboot command, boot-ready timeout, stable inventory baseline, event allowlist, safety stops and approved count override.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: A lower approved count completes only the project run and records the missing Master cycles.

original_method: The warm-reboot method and 100-cycle count are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use PA Manager Cycle or the approved platform script if it preserves per-cycle boot readiness, inventory and evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact fully populated target at qualified margin.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved PA Manager/project cycle SOP and platform reboot specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds an immutable cycle ledger without creating a second controller.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Must retain the approved warm-reboot count and device checks.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Reboot semantics, readiness, inventory and stop rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fixture drift or failed reboot can remove control.

missing_inputs: Approved reboot command and readiness timeout
Full expected inventory and error allowlist
safety_boundaries: No hidden retry, counter reset or log clearing
Stop on loss of control or hardware safety limit
no_automatic_retry: The next planned loop is allowed; any replacement for a failed loop needs approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: Cycle/margin engineer owns completion and disposition.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already separated cycle execution from formal verdict and preserved 100-loop coverage with no automatic retry.
